articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: Democrats 'chose visceral hatred for' Donald Trump over crypto Clarity Act, Lummis says
articles.snippet: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the crypto industry should "pin it on the Democrats" in her first public remarks after last week's failed Clarity Act vote.

articles.title: Trump reveals up to $100K Strategy stock purchase in ethics filing
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump disclosed a July purchase of Strategy shares as his administration continues to advance crypto policy through federal regulators and Congress.

articles.title: US Treasury secretary emerges as frontrunner for Trump’s AI czar role: Report
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump previously tapped David Sacks as his AI and crypto czar before Sacks stepped down from the role earlier this year after reaching his service limit as a special government employee.

articles.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
articles.snippet: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.
